features.title: Landing page
features.user_visible_behavior: Display a landing page with product introduction, Login, and Get Started buttons. Login navigates to the login page; Get Started navigates to the sign-up page.
verification: Open the app and verify the landing page renders correctly.
Click Login and verify navigation to the login page.
Click Get Started and verify navigation to the sign-up page.
evidence: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend build
features.notes: Landing page implemented with dark premium styling and CTA/auth entry states; verified by build and successful HTTP 200 from the running Vite frontend.

features.title: Login page
features.user_visible_behavior: Display a login box with email and password fields, a Login button, and the text "Don't have an account? Sign up" at the bottom. Sign up is an embedded link to the sign-up page.
verification: Open the login page and verify all elements render correctly.
Verify the Sign up link appears at the bottom of the login box.
Click Sign up and verify navigation to the sign-up page.
